title: feat(messaging): Setup lists the Slack page where connector-slack is composed (Part of #34730)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D62xGLMbyWJaMEVnAMEjTK1)_
Part of #34730
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在接入了 Slack 连接器的部署上，组织管理员在“设置 › 集成”菜单里多了一个“Slack”入口，点开就是上一张界面改动做好的 Slack 管理页；没有接入 Slack 的部署菜单不变。
- 为什么做：这是「Slack 私信通知」专题第三步的服务端一半，补上管理页的菜单入口，同时补写上一步欠下的一句更新说明。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是入口不出现或排在别的位置，管理页本身仍可用地址直接打开；改动只加一个菜单项，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Step 3 of #34730, server half: Setup's menu entry for the Slack page that PR #35968 adds (component `messaging:slack`, gated by `setup.write`, today reachable only at `/apps/setup/component/messaging/slack`). This PR was written in session `session_016WV4czKnDE6hsyXQzB9wB2`.

- **The entry** (`service-messaging/src/slack-setup-ui.ts`): `SLACK_SETUP_UI_BUNDLE` contributes Setup › Integrations (`group_integrations`) › **Slack**, `type: 'component'`, `componentRef: 'messaging:slack'`, `requiredPermissions: ['setup.write']` (the `SLACK_ADMIN_CAPABILITY` every Slack administrator door asks), priority 140: after Connector Credentials / Connector Connections (120), before Cloud Connection (200). The shape copies `CONNECTOR_CREDENTIALS_UI_BUNDLE` in service-automation.
- **Registered only where the slack channel registers**: `MessagingServicePlugin` registers the bundle through the `manifest` service inside the same `kernel:ready` hook as the `slack` channel, after the same `if (!getSlack()) return;`. Without connector-slack, no entry. A composition with no `manifest` service gets no entry and still boots (the pattern's try/catch).
- **Nav label i18n, the pattern's way**: `apps.setup.navigation.nav_slack.label` = `Slack` (the product name, kept verbatim as `Webhooks` is in `zh-CN`) in all eleven platform locales under `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/`, with the source digest recorded in the seven locales that record one for the neighbouring `nav_connector_connections` (`c3c9e181e8c74b22`, computed with `hashSource`; control: `Connector Connections` reproduces the committed `949e9a8fd25c3d57`).
- **Gates that judge the entry**: `packages/cli/scripts/check-app-nav-i18n.mjs` gains a roster row reading `SLACK_SETUP_UI_BUNDLE` (the `service-automation` row's shape, since the bundle registers at `kernel:ready`), so the label is judged in every locale; `packages/cli/test/setup-integrations-order.pin.test.ts` orders it as its own tier. `packages/cli/vitest.config.ts` resolves `@objectstack/service-messaging` to source (`check:test-source-alias` asked for it); `packages/services/service-messaging/vitest.config.ts` declares `OS_REGISTRY_LOG: 'warn'` (`check:registry-log-declared` asked for it, since the new pin folds a `SchemaRegistry`).
- **Changeset** (`.changeset/34730-s3b-slack-setup-entry.md`, patch on service-messaging and platform-objects): the entry, plus the sentence owed from step 2: the topic `messaging.slack_link_removed` is listed by `GET /api/v1/messaging/preference-options` and `GET /api/v1/messaging/me/preferences` on every deployment, and is emitted only where connector-slack is composed (when an administrator removes a person's link or the organization's install).

Read first: `messaging-service-plugin.ts` (the hook, the riskiest hunk: the registration must stay behind the slack guard), `slack-setup-ui.ts`, `slack-channel-composition.test.ts`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run src/slack-channel-composition.test.ts` shows 5 passed, among them "with a slack service: the entry is registered once and served under Integrations" and "without a slack service: no entry is registered and Integrations serves none".

## Evals

Base `523ada4cc0`; tests below at `fd50ed384d` / `60b28db358` (final head; the last commit only adds the cli alias).

<details><summary>Pins: with and without connector-slack, through the Setup app fold</summary>

The new top-level describe sits in the existing slack composition harness (`slack-channel-composition.test.ts`), whose `compose({ slack })` boots `MessagingServicePlugin` with and without connector-slack's `slack` service. The harness now records what the plugin registers with `manifest`, and each side folds those manifests into the Setup app the way the meta door serves it (`SchemaRegistry.registerApp(SETUP_APP)` + `setPackageNavContributions`, then `getApp('setup')`):

- with slack: the bundle is registered exactly once, and `group_integrations` serves `nav_slack` with `componentRef: 'messaging:slack'` and `requiredPermissions: ['setup.write']`;
- without slack (control): no bundle, no `nav_slack` in the served group, while the same boot registered the messaging manifest;
- the bundle parses as a `ManifestSchema`, and `setup.write` is a declared org-scoped platform capability.

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging test` on `fd50ed384d`: `Test Files 79 passed (79)`, `Tests 1060 passed (1060)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/setup-integrations-order.pin.test.ts` on `60b28db358`: `Tests 1 passed (1)`.
`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run src/apps/translations/`: `Test Files 26 passed (26)`, `Tests 587 passed (587)`.
`node packages/cli/scripts/check-app-nav-i18n.mjs`: `OK (14 contributor(s), 11 locale(s), 2 app(s) — setup: 61 merged nav id(s), account: 15 merged nav id(s) — every id labelled in every locale)`; `--self-test` exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (all through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored to HEAD with git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- Registration removed (`...register(SLACK_SETUP_UI_BUNDLE);` replaced by a marker): anchor 1 to 0, blob `794db597159a` to `a5675d9a239f`; `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (5)`, the failure being "with a slack service: the entry is registered once and served under Integrations".
- Slack guard removed (`if (!getSlack()) return;`): anchor 1 to 0; `Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`: both "without a slack service" cases, the step-2 channel pin and the new entry pin.
- Priority 140 to 250: the cli order pin fails with `expected Set{ 'nav_cloud_connection' } to deeply equal Set{ 'nav_slack' }`.

The messaging tests import the plugin by relative path (source), and the cli pin reaches source through the new alias, so no rebuild sits between mutation and run.
</details>

<details><summary>Type-check and gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 77 commands on the final head `60b28db358`: all 77 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 77 of 77 with a derived zero NOT-MEASURED. First run (74 on `5380a29a6a`) was red on `check:registry-log-declared` and `check:test-source-alias` (fixed by the two vitest config entries above) and refused on a missing build for `check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3; green after building the closures they name).
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=claude/area-a4W-34730-s3b`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` (no open PR shares a file).
- Not run locally, CI's: the whole `@objectstack/cli` unit layer (a two-worker local run passed 570 s without finishing and was stopped, so it is NOT MEASURED here; Test Core runs it).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- File surface is wider than the claim amendment's `packages/services/service-messaging/src/**`: the order asks for nav label i18n "following the pattern", and the pattern's labels live in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/` and are judged by the cli roster gate and order pin, so those files, and the two vitest configs the gates asked for, ride here. No ui, spec or skills change.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` measured: the entry adds no authorable key, value or metadata type; it is a navigation contribution a deployment without connector-slack never sees (it is not registered there).
- The pin reads the entry through the registry fold the `/api/v1/meta/app` door serves, not through an HTTP request to that door; booting ObjectQL plus REST in service-messaging's suite would add a full engine boot for the same fold.
